# Tile

<!-- MAP:START (generated by .kiro/scripts/build-docs.py from rp-map.json) -->
**`rp-tile`** = `Tile` · `@reviewpro/ui-components/Tile` · Figma: TileState · no class = `variant="default"`

| Class | Code |
|---|---|
| `rp-tile-error` | variant="error" |
| `rp-tile-edit` | variant="edit" |
| `rp-tile-secondary` | variant="secondary" |
| `rp-tile-outlined` | variant="outlined" |
| `rp-tile-deactivated` | deactivated |
| `rp-tile-title` | TileTitle |
| `rp-tile-title-text` | TileTitle text column |
| `rp-tile-title-label` | TileTitle label |
| `rp-tile-title-secondary` | TileTitle secondaryText |
| `rp-tile-title-actions` | TileTitle children (actions) |
| `rp-tile-title-no-wrap` | TileTitle noWrap |
| `rp-tile-content` | TileContent |
| `rp-tile-table` | TileTable |
| `rp-tile-actions` | TileActions |
| `rp-tile-expand` | TileExpand |
| `rp-tile-expand-label` | TileExpand label |
| `rp-tile-expand-content` | content shown when TileExpand is expanded |
| `rp-tile-alert` | TileAlert |
| `rp-tile-tabs` | TileTabs |
| `rp-tile-expanded` | TileExpand isExpanded |
<!-- MAP:END -->

The container of every admin widget (`Tile` → `TileTitle` → `TileContent` / `TileTable` → `TileActions`). Content never sits directly on the grey page background.

```html
<section class="rp-tile">
  <div class="rp-tile-title">
    <span class="rp-icon rp-icon-size-32 rp-icon-profile"></span>            <!-- optional icon -->
    <div class="rp-tile-title-text">
      <h2 class="rp-tile-title-label">Manage Users</h2>
      <p class="rp-tile-title-secondary">People who can access the establishments of Coastal Hotels Group</p>
    </div>
    <div class="rp-tile-title-actions"><button type="button" class="rp-main-button rp-main-button-size-small">Add user</button></div>
  </div>
  <div class="rp-tile-content">Padded content (16px sides)</div>
  <div class="rp-tile-table"><table class="rp-table">…</table></div>   <!-- edge to edge -->
  <div class="rp-tile-actions">
    <button type="button" class="rp-default-button rp-default-button-size-small">Cancel</button>
    <button type="button" class="rp-main-button rp-main-button-size-small" data-rp-validate="Profile updated">Save changes</button>
  </div>
  <button type="button" class="rp-tile-expand" aria-expanded="false" data-rp-label-expanded="Show fewer sources"><span class="rp-tile-expand-label">Show all sources</span><span class="rp-icon rp-icon-down"></span></button>
</section>
```
- Variants: `rp-tile-edit` (inline edit), `rp-tile-secondary` (nested), `rp-tile-outlined` (selected), `rp-tile-error`, `rp-tile-deactivated`.
- Tabs at the top edge of a tile: `<div class="rp-tabs rp-tile-tabs">` (see `rp-tabs.md`).
- Tile expand: content with `rp-tile-expand-content` (a `div` or a `tbody`) shows when the tile is expanded.
- Tiles stack with `kit-stack` and sit side by side with `kit-grid` (`style="--kit-columns: 4"`).

## Rules
- Tile titles in Title Case, secondary text in sentence case.
- A tile has a title unless it only holds tabs or a toolbar.
- Every part has 16px margins: never add extra padding around tile parts.
